QUOTE: "a contributor adds a code by adding a documented define and regenerating, not by hand-editing `error.c`." and "Add the define to the module's header with a doxygen comment... Regenerate with `make` in `library/` or the CMake build, or run `perl scripts/generate_errors.pl`... Don't hand-edit `library/error.c`."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer explicitly says to add a doxygen-documented #define to the module header, re-run the generator, and not hand-edit library/error.c.
